name: Local Page Optimization Report 2026-05-30
body:
> Report · 2026-05-30

# Summary
Report prepared for Kim on 2026-05-30 on optimizing local service-area pages for SEO, GEO (generative engines) and AEO (answer engines) across Summit, Alphalete and Pipeliners. It defines the three layers, then gives per-client status, what was delivered and next steps. The shorter Kim-format version is [Optimization Report 2026-05-30](lib:brain-optimization-report-2026-05-30).

# Per client
**Summit Plumbing Pros (Phoenix/East Valley): complete and live.**
- 11 service lines x 10 cities = 110 location pages.
- Custom `summit-location-seo.php` mu-plugin renders Plumber + FAQPage JSON-LD; FAQs supplied per page via `_summit_faqs_cache` post meta, no Elementor edits.
- SEO: keyword in H1/title/meta/slug, Plumber + Service schema with areaServed, internal links. GEO: real neighborhoods (Sun Lakes, McCormick Ranch, Ahwatukee), local trees, build-era pipe detail. AEO: 7 search-style FAQs per page.
- SiteGround (Supercacher purge after changes), GHL forms, standardized phone link.

**Alphalete Trenchless (Colorado Springs / Southern CO): SEO live, FAQ schema built but dormant.**
- 3 service lines x about 43 cities = 131 location pages; `alphalete-seo-helpers.php` mu-plugin emits Service + Plumber schema.
- All 131 titles standardized to "[Service] in [City], CO | Alphalete"; wrong-city bugs fixed (Florissant and Franktown showed Florence, Rockvale showed Ramah, Green Mountain Falls truncated), "Alphalette" typo and Canon City spelling fixed.
- 84 templated meta descriptions rewritten with verified county/region tags.
- FAQPage layer added in mu-plugin v1.3.0, deliberately dormant until per-page FAQs match the visible accordions.
- Guardrail: no invented specs (no PSI, no "lasts 50 years", no price comparisons). Hostinger, Yoast, LiteSpeed Cache; on-server TSV backups before changes.

**Pipeliners: not started.** Hosting and SSH ready; site runs the Search Atlas/Metasync `otto-dynamic-indexing-module` (third-party). Recommended: apply the same model.

# Next steps
1. Alphalete: deploy the FAQ layer with per-page FAQs.
2. Pipeliners: scope the location pages and run the same optimization.
3. All: re-check GSC in 2 to 4 weeks for indexing, CTR and impressions.
